description: Elections Commission - Notify the name of B. A. G. M. K. G. G. Kumari as a member of the Nuwaragam Palatha East P/S
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a Member of the Nuwaragam Palatha East Pradeshiya Sabha due to death, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local government body, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new elected member by a returning officer, which falls under election-related matters.
